body:
The unit-5 circle animation now waits before entering `BLITZ`, matching the qualified opening lessons. Its historical capture input types the same maintained source; the comment no longer asserts an unmeasured frame rate.

Verified in FS-UAE/A1200 with AmiBlitz 3.13.0b: changed baseline, fixed-colour 80/200-circle variants, zero increment and 0.01 increment all compile; observed motion/stillness and mouse exits are retained with the lesson evidence. The historical capture driver was not replayed. No performance benchmark is claimed.

Part of code198x/website#776. Merge before the matching website lesson PR.

Coordinated set: [samples #101](https://github.com/code198x/code-samples/pull/101), [lessons #778](https://github.com/code198x/website/pull/778), [evidence #100](https://github.com/code198x/docs/pull/100). Merge samples before lessons.
title: Let Workbench settle before the unit-5 animation
